rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for firmly maintaining a claim or refusing to give up a demand.

example.english: I insist I never said that.
example.traditional: 我堅持自己冇講過嗰句嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin1 ci4 zi6 gei2 mou5 gong2 gwo3 go2 geoi3 je5

rows.note: Use this for stubbornly asserting that a particular claim is true, especially in spoken contexts.

example.english: They insist they didn't steal the money.
example.jyutping: keoi5 ngaau5 ding6 zi6 gei2 mou5 tau1 cin2

rows.note: Use this when insisting that someone do something or that something happen.

example.english: I insist you pay me back now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin1 ci4 jiu3 nei5 ji4 gaa1 waan4 cin2
